missing.title: READ THE FIELD
missing.text: Systems checked. Watch each module?s readiness and the security warning zones. Keep your escape route open while defending.

missing.title: YOUR INSTALLED MODS
missing.text: These five docks show the Mods installed for your next deployment. Each slot accepts its matching category, while Utility can support flexible builds.

missing.title: OPEN MOD COLLECTION
missing.text: The Mod Collection is where recovered cards are inspected, upgraded, infused, equipped, or recycled. Click MOD COLLECTION to continue.

missing.title: RECOVERED MOD ARCHIVE
missing.text: Every Mod card recovered during a run appears in this archive. Rarity, rank, infusion, and duplicate status remain attached to the exact card.

missing.title: INSPECT YOUR BUILD
missing.text: Select a card to read its complete effect and manage compatible loadout slots. New Mods create new ways to approach future rounds.

missing.title: TEACHING COMPLETE
missing.text: Your workstation is ready. Keep earning Credits, improving Mods, adapting your build, and pushing farther.

missing.title: MOD RECOVERED
missing.text: Mods are awarded immediately. Visit the Mod Collection to inspect, upgrade, infuse, and equip the exact card you found.

missing.title: CORRUPTED MOD
missing.text: Corrupted Mods carry an exceptional advantage and a real drawback. Read both effects before installing one.

missing.title: LEGENDARY LOADOUT RULE
missing.text: Legendary Mods are extremely rare. Only one Legendary Mod may be equipped across the entire loadout.

missing.title: BOMB DEFUSE IN PROGRESS
missing.text: Enemies are actively disarming the highlighted bomb. Eliminate or interrupt every defuser before their progress completes. The red HUD alert, yellow caution icon, warning audio, and striped site perimeter remain active while the danger continues.

missing.title: OWNED CARD ARCHIVE
missing.text: Every acquired copy appears here. Border color identifies rarity; the duplicate marker counts extra copies regardless of upgrade level.

missing.title: INSPECT & CONFIGURE
missing.text: The viewer shows the selected card's rank, infusion, category, and complete effect. Equip it to a compatible slot or the Utility/Wildcard dock.

missing.title: INSTALL A MOD
missing.text: Use a valid category slot or the Utility/Wildcard dock whenever you want to install the selected card into the real next-deployment loadout.

missing.title: UPGRADE OR RECYCLE
missing.text: Upgrade favorite cards with the displayed currencies. Unupgraded duplicate copies can be recycled into Plasma Chips.

missing.title: BOSS SIGNAL DETECTED
missing.text: The highlighted boss combines its complete attack kit with arena security. Read the telegraphs, preserve Energy, and keep moving.

missing.title: RETURN STRONGER
missing.text: Credits survive failed deployments. Spend them in the Store on permanent upgrades, then deploy again.

missing.title: CREDITS
missing.text: This wallet value shows your Credits. Credits persist after every deployment and purchase permanent combat upgrades, cosmetics, and Mod improvements.

missing.title: CORE TOKENS
missing.text: This wallet value shows Core Tokens, a persistent rare resource used by higher-rarity Mod upgrades and select unlocks.

missing.title: CHOOSE A SYSTEM
missing.text: Each highlighted module shows its current level, next improvement, and exact cost. Select one to inspect it.

missing.title: INSTALL AN UPGRADE
missing.text: Try an available upgrade. A successful install persists across every future run; if funds are short, the Store shows the exact amount still needed.

missing.title: OPERATOR GARAGE
missing.text: Your Garage shows what is installed for the next deployment. Configure Mods, Signals, Contracts, cosmetics, and presets here.

missing.title: NEXT DEPLOYMENT LOADOUT
missing.text: These five highlighted docks contain the Mods installed for your next deployment. Browse or unequip cards independently by slot.

missing.title: OPERATIONS CONFIGURATION
missing.text: This terminal opens Operations, where you choose an unlocked mode and starting checkpoint. Contracts, Signals, fees, and progression remain linked to the same next deployment.

missing.title: OVERDRIVE UNLOCKED
missing.text: This station opens Overdrive progression. Its constellation tiers let experienced operatives begin at later rounds after meeting each highest-round requirement.

entries.title: WELCOME TO THE ARENA, OPERATIVE!
entries.text:
Welcome, Operative. I am LYRA — your Tactical Systems Intelligence Assistant. TSIA, if brevity becomes necessary. It usually does.

Beginning RWG-recommended training and systems calibration.

We’ll start with movement, then proceed to arming and defending a planted charge.

I’ll remain on comms. You handle the shooting. I find our arrangement considerably safer that way.

entries.title: ADVANCED OPERATIONS // FIELD RECORDING
entries.text:
Operative... this is a preview of Supreme Operations.

This is where your training eventually leads. The arena is considerably less forgiving by then.

Try to keep up.

Don’t worry. We’ll begin somewhere significantly less suicidal.

entries.title: START LOCAL
entries.text:
Begin your first training run here.

START LOCAL launches standard play without publishing your score to the online leaderboards.

Select START LOCAL when you’re ready, Operative.

entries.title: RETURN TO LOCAL TRAINING
entries.text:
Arena training is still in progress.

Select START LOCAL to resume your training deployment. I kept everything exactly where you left it. Mostly.

entries.title: WELCOME, OPERATIVE
entries.text:
LYRA online.

This is a live deployment exercise. We’ll begin with movement and weapons calibration.

Continue when you’re ready, Operative.

entries.title: MOVE YOUR OPERATIVE
entries.text:
Use W, A, S, and D to move.

A stationary operative makes an exceptionally convenient target. The security systems appreciate your cooperation.

entries.title: AIM AT THREATS
entries.text:
Neural link established. Motor control appears functional.

...Encouraging.

Use the MOUSE to aim toward your reticle. Movement and targeting operate independently.

entries.title: FIRE YOUR WEAPON
entries.text:
Targeting link confirmed.

Press LEFT MOUSE BUTTON to fire.

Remember: your weapon consumes energy, Operative. Accuracy is considerably cheaper than panic.

entries.title: ARM THE CHARGE
entries.text:
Move into the available bombsite and hold E to plant the charge.

Once armed, defend it until detonation.

And when the timer reaches zero, I recommend being somewhere else. The cleanup drones have already filed several complaints.

entries.title: HOSTILE CONTACT
entries.text:
Charge armed.

Engage a hostile and confirm weapons contact.

Enemies may attempt to disarm the device. Stop them before they succeed, then defend the charge until detonation.

entries.title: OPERATIVE VITALS
entries.text:
Weapons confirmed.

Red represents Health. Cyan represents Energy.

Collect the corresponding pickups when either becomes depleted. I strongly recommend maintaining both.

entries.title: RAISE YOUR SHIELD
entries.text:
Operative, let’s improve your chances of surviving this.

Press MIDDLE MOUSE BUTTON to activate your SHIELD.

Shielding consumes energy and requires time to recharge before it can be activated again.

Use it deliberately. These operative frames are not what RWG would describe as... disposable.

entries.title: DASH THROUGH DANGER
entries.text:
RWG has provided several additional methods of keeping you alive, including the DASH system.

Press SPACE BAR to surge toward your current aim direction.

Dashing — as you may have suspected — consumes energy and has a cooldown.

Your survival will depend heavily on managing Health, Energy, movement, and timing. Preferably all four simultaneously.

entries.text:

RWG reminds all operatives that it accepts no liability for improper placement, accidental detonation, personal injury, or death.

A remarkably comprehensive waiver.

entries.title: BUILD A FENCE
entries.text:
Press Q to deploy an electric fence.

Fences can slow enemies and temporarily restrict their movement.

R&D also recommends firing through active fences. Their report describes the resulting effect as, quote, “wondrous.”

I requested a more technical explanation. None was provided. Use your discretion, Operative.

entries.title: DEPLOY A TURRET
entries.text:
Press F to deploy RWG’s latest personal-security platform: an automated turret.

Turrets can defend territory while you attend to other threats.

Consider them temporary arena partners. Being everywhere at once is difficult.

They seem less troubled by the limitation.

entries.title: READ THE FIELD
entries.text: Systems checked. Watch each module?s readiness and the security warning zones. Keep your escape route open while defending.

entries.title: YOU HAVE THE FIELD
entries.text:
Systems calibrated.

Monitor the readiness and cooldown state of your defensive modules during combat.

RWG Training Manual, Entry 47-A — Mobility and Survival — recommends remaining mobile, managing your resources, and collecting available pickups whenever conditions allow.

For once, the manual is correct.

Training calibration complete.

Good luck, Operative.

LYRA standing by.
